findings.current: “You were going on about the orthodox faction and the Great Zhongnan Sect, but the moment you lost your temper, you turned into a demon king. Why not just rename the sect the Zhong-gangnan Sect while you’re at it?”
findings.defect: The opaque invented form “Zhong-gangnan” fails to convey the insulting wordplay on Zhongnan’s name, while “demon king” overstates the generic 마두 as a specific exalted title.
findings.rationale: 종간나 파 is a profane distortion of the sect’s name, and 마두 means a demonic fiend rather than a demon king.
findings.replacement: “You went on about the orthodox faction and the Great Zhongnan Sect, but the second you lost your temper, you became no better than a demonic fiend. Why not rename yourselves the Zhong-Bastard Sect while you’re at it?”
findings.source: “정파가 어쩌고, 대종남파가 어쩌고 하더니 꼭지 한 번 도니까 마두가 따로 없네. 차라리 이참에 종간나 파로 이름 바꾸는 게 어떻습니까.”

findings.current: “The way you’re acting right now, Senior Martial Uncle… Isn’t this something a disciple of the Great Zhongnan Sect should do.”
findings.defect: The English reverses the negation and says that Hwangbo Eom’s conduct is appropriate for a Great Zhongnan disciple.
findings.rationale: Hyuk Sopyung is condemning Hwangbo Eom’s conduct as something a Great Zhongnan disciple should not do.
findings.replacement: “The way you’re acting right now, Senior Martial Uncle… Isn’t this beneath a disciple of the Great Zhongnan Sect?”
findings.source: “이건, 지금 사숙께서 보이는 모습은…… 대종남파의 제자가 할 짓이 아니지 않습니까.”

findings.current: “This is the Sect Leader’s Command Token, entrusted to this old man by your Master. Do you still intend to refuse?”
findings.defect: The draft omits 본문의, which explicitly identifies the token as belonging to their sect.
findings.rationale: 본문 means “our sect” or “this sect” here and reinforces the institutional authority Hwangbo Eom is invoking.
findings.replacement: “This is our sect’s Sect Leader’s Command Token, entrusted to this old man by your Master. Do you still intend to refuse?”
findings.source: “네 사부가 노부에게 맡기고 간 본문의 장문령부이니라. 이래도 거부할 생각이더냐?”

findings.current: Then he gave a bitter smile and slammed his head against the copper tablet in a deep prostration.
findings.defect: The draft changes the physical action by stating that Hyuk Sopyung strikes the tablet itself; the source says he prostrates toward the tablet and bangs his head down.
findings.rationale: 동패를 향해 modifies the direction of his prostration, while 머리를 찧었다 describes the forceful kowtow that splits his forehead.
findings.replacement: Then he gave a bitter smile, bowed deeply toward the copper tablet, and slammed his forehead against the floor.
findings.source: 이내 쓴웃음을 지은 그가 동패를 향해 큰절과 함께 머리를 찧었다.

findings.current: *The young tiger is in danger, yet the great tiger still refuses to wake.*
findings.defect: “Refuses” assigns deliberate volition to the unconscious Jeok Cheongang, whereas the source mocks the fact that he remains unconscious and shows no sign of waking.
findings.rationale: 깨어날 줄 모르는구나 describes his continued failure to wake, not a conscious refusal.
findings.replacement: *The young tiger is in danger, yet the great tiger shows no sign of waking.*
findings.source: - 새끼 호랑이가 위기에 처했건만, 대호(大虎)는 깨어날 줄 모르는구나.

findings.current:
I should never have brought up Jeok Cheongang over something as trivial as this.

I truly should not have.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the subject and makes Taekyung blame himself for mentioning Jeok Cheongang, when he is condemning Hwangbo Eom for doing so.
findings.rationale: The preceding accusation is addressed to Hwangbo Eom, and these lines explain that Hwangbo Eom crossed the line by invoking Jeok Cheongang.
findings.replacement:
He should never have brought up Jeok Cheongang over something as trivial as this.

He truly shouldn’t have.
findings.source:
고작 이 정도로 적천강을 입에 올려서는 안 됐다.

정말 그래서는 안 되는 거였다.

findings.defect: “Come in” sounds like an invitation to enter rather than a challenge to attack, and “shitty” weakens the explicit force of 좆 같은.
findings.rationale: 들어와 challenges Hwangbo Eom to come at him, while 좆 같은 is strong, explicit profanity.

findings.current: The old man’s body staggered beneath the violence of his martial arts and the strength of a physique that had entered the realm beyond humanity.
findings.defect: The possessive “his” attributes the martial art and superhuman physique to the old man, reversing whose power makes Hwangbo Eom stagger.
findings.rationale: Hwangbo Eom is being overwhelmed by Taekyung’s superhuman physical strength and the inherent ferocity of the Fire Dragon Divine Spear.
findings.replacement: The old man staggered under my strength, which had entered the realm beyond humanity, and the innate ferocity of my martial art.
findings.source: 부릅뜬 눈. 인외의 경지에 접어든 근력과 무공 본연이 가진 난폭함에 노인의 신형이 휘청인다.

summary: The draft contains two critical subject/negation reversals, one altered physical action, and several meaningful losses of humor, register, and agency.
